_comment: Org teams and their repo grants; applied by `scripts/governance.py teams`. `members` is a list of logins, or `@org-members` (every org member) or `@org-owners` (every org owner), read from GitHub at run time. `repos` maps repo -> permission (pull, triage, push, maintain, admin); `*` means every non-archived repo. Outside collaborators are not managed here.

employees.description: Every org member: write on every non-archived repo.

admins.description: Org owners: admin on every non-archived repo.

security.description: Coders responsible for security checks on code
